Beautiful 48-piece vintage Noritake Ivory China dinnerware set in the retired Heather pattern (7548), manufactured in Japan. This elegant service for six features delicate gray floral detailing around the borders, complemented by genuine platinum trim. The classic ivory-colored china and understated design make this a timeless addition to any formal dining collection. The set includes six matching place settings, an additional saucer, and five serving pieces. Included Pieces: * 6 Dinner Plates 27 cm (10.6”) * 6 Salad Plates 21 cm (8.3”) * 6 Bread & Butter Plates 16 cm (6.3”) * 6 Rimmed Soup Bowls 19 cm (7.5”) * 6 Dessert/Fruit Bowls approximately 14 cm (5.5”) * 6 Teacups * 7 Saucers approximately 15 cm (5.9”) * 1 Gravy Boat with Attached Underplate * 1 Creamer/Milk Jug * 1 Covered Sugar Bowl with Lid * 1 Large Oval Serving Bowl * 1 Oval Serving Platter Total: 49 pieces, counting the covered sugar bowl and lid as one item. Manufacturer: Noritake Collection: Ivory China Pattern: Heather (7548) Country of Manufacture: Japan Trim: Platinum Pattern Production: Approximately 19661989 Condition: Very good pre-owned condition overall, with minor signs of wear consistent with light use. No chips or cracks were observed during inspection. Some minor surface wear may be present. All pieces display the matching Noritake Heather pattern, including the separately marked oval serving bowl and platter. A lovely, substantial vintage dinnerware collection, suitable for entertaining, formal dining, or adding replacement pieces to an existing Noritake Heather service.
Please review all photographs carefully, as they form part of the description and show the exact items included in this lot.

283487821.description:
Vintage Vest Pocket Smoking Pipe
Folding Swiveling Stem Estate Pipe
Carved Wood & Metal, Approximately 5.25 Inches
Designed for portability and discreet carry, the vest pocket pipe originated in the early-to-mid 20th century as a compact travel alternative to standard tobacco pipes. Featuring an oval, low-profile bowl and a rotating stem mechanism, this functional design folds flat to easily slip into a waistcoat or jacket pocket without creating bulk.
Carved textured wood stummel with an oval chamber designed for compact carry
Rotating swivel stem design that aligns flush with the bowl for pocket storage
Polished metal ferrule band joining the shank and mouthpiece
Dark stem accented with an inlaid spade emblem
Condition:
Pre-owned estate condition. The bowl chamber exhibits visible carbon buildup and char from prior use. The exterior wood finish displays natural grain wear, surface darkening, and light handling marks. The metal band shows minor surface patina, and the stem retains its shape with slight surface oxidation and light handling wear near the bit.

Handcrafted Porcelain Smoking Pipe With Box & Insert Bowls
High-Fire Glazed Porcelain, Circa 1970s
Vintage artistic smoking pipe handcrafted by Ishod Arts, Inc., featuring high-fire porcelain construction with distinctive sculpted relief panels. One side displays a celestial smiling sun surrounded by radiant rays and stars, while the opposite side features an armorial crest shield. Complete with its original satin-lined presentation box, paper guarantee insert, and two removable terracotta bowl inserts designed for convenient cleaning and thermal protection.
High-fire glazed white porcelain body with mottled earth-tone accents and bright orange collar
Dual-sided dark metallic-toned relief plaques depicting sun face and heraldic crest designs
Removable black curved stem and two vented terracotta ceramic bowl liners
Includes original stamped cardboard box with red satin lining and printed guarantee document
Condition:
Porcelain body is structurally sound with no cracks, chips, or restorations. Raised relief ornamentation is crisp and intact. One terracotta bowl insert shows interior residue from prior smoking, while the second insert appears clean. Curved stem attaches securely. Presentation box shows minor vintage surface and corner wear; interior satin fabric and guarantee paper remain well preserved.
